name: Workable
description: Connect your AI assistant directly to Workable. With 40+ tools spanning the full hiring lifecycle, you can manage jobs, move candidates through pipeline stages, add reviews and comments, handle requisitions and offers, and access employee and HR data all without leaving your AI interface. Whether you're sourcing talent, tracking approvals, or pulling workforce insights, the Workable MCP server turns natural language into real actions across your recruiting and HR operations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Workable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Workable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.workable.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Workable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Workable lists 45 MCP tools, including get_candidates, get_candidate, disqualify_candidate, move_candidate, get_candidate_activities, get_candidate_activity, get_disqualification_reasons, add_comment, create_candidate, create_talent_pool_candidate, add_review, and get_candidate_offer.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Workable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Workable in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Workable requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Workable is developed by Workable. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
